title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with our city-by-city guide and price comparison
intro: Aucklanders have plenty of gym options to choose from, with prices ranging from $10 to $50 per week. With so many gyms to choose from, it can be hard to decide which one is best for you. In this guide, we'll break down the best gyms in Auckland by suburb and price.

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms in Auckland
sections.body: For those who want to fit in a workout on their way to or from work, there are several commuter gyms in Auckland to choose from. These gyms are usually located near public transport hubs and offer short-term contracts or casual memberships.

sections.heading: Parking and Amenities
sections.body: When choosing a gym, it's not just about the price. You should also consider the parking options and amenities available. Some gyms in Auckland offer free parking, while others may have limited parking options. Additionally, some gyms may offer extra amenities such as pools, steam rooms, or personal training sessions.
